Nokkhi Jinjahl's job is to make quivers, bullet pouches, and card cases.  Trade her 99 arrows, bolts, bullets, or cards and one [[Carnation]] to receive a quiver, pouch, or case respectively.  You can trade more than one set at a time, just be sure to give her one [[Carnation]] for each stack of 99 arrows, bolts, bullets, or cards.  She doesn't quiver all types of [[:category:Ammunition|Ammunition]], only the ones listed below:
